name: the door wall of a lift car seen flat from the front: a brushed-steel wall with panel seams, two closed door leaves in a frame with a lit floor display above, a call panel on the right (round buttons, a speaker grille, an alarm button) cut by the frame, a capacity plate on the left and a dark threshold floor; the hook is plain clean off-white
fits: anything about a sound that is easy to hear in a quiet small place: stomach rumbles, hiccups, a creaking joint, a ringing in the ears; the hero is a stomach with its small intestine floating in front of the closed doors, with its contents (gas, fluid, food) seen through the wall
recipe: flat 2D front view, no iso, one scale: a steel wall rect with vertical seams and soft highlight bands, a door frame, two door leaves with a dark seam and a brushed stripe pattern, a floor display of a dark rounded rect with a yellow digit, a call panel of a rounded rect with eight round buttons, a grille of dots and a yellow alarm button, a capacity plate with mono text, a dark floor with a threshold line; the stomach is a J-shaped bag with a rounded wall and a pale cavity holding fluid, gas bubbles and a food lump, and the small intestine is a thick tube in three rows with a squeeze wave and bubbles flowing along it
